title: Accounts

commands.report: 135 unit tests pass; accounts/destinations/connections suites cover A01/A02/A04/A05, target contract, reference cleanup and connection atomicity

tests: A01 credential rotation keeps the account id and only bumps revisions
A02 a flag patch preserves label/config/secrets/createdAt
A04 deleting an account removes destinations, principals, pairing, refs, cursors and route/settings references in one commit
A05 account and destination views expose secret paths but never secret values
destination target requires declared fields and defaults the kind
secret destination target fields are captured into destination.secrets
connections.create commits account + first destination together with no orphan on failure
makeDefault appends and advances settings.revision once
